name: PLATO Concorde-TSP with Different LP Solvers
description: Benchmarks the Concorde traveling salesman problem solver using different LP solver backends (CPLEX and QSopt) on 23 instances from the standard TSPLIB collection. Problems range from 561 to 5,934 cities. The benchmark measures wall-clock time for exact TSP solutions, comparing how the choice of LP solver affects Concorde's overall performance.
typical_sota_score: CPLEX backend: 2–22,857 seconds depending on instance; QSopt: 6–86,400+ seconds.
reputation: Maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU; standard reference for TSP solver comparisons in the operations research community.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Instances from TSPLIB. Timings are highly hardware-dependent. CPLEX backend substantially faster than QSopt on large instances.
